decisions.reason: The one-clip authorization concerns immediate online publishing, not the separate monthly quota of 100 client-approved clips.
Limiting immediate publication to one clip does not change the Lead Clipper pathway, compensation, training, or responsibilities.
The source decision occurs after qualification and changes publishing authorization, not the qualification method or success condition.
The clips remain client-approved, and the rule that only approved clips may be posted remains unchanged; the source only limits how many approved clips may currently be published.
The publication-count restriction does not change any clip-duration or minimum-approval-duration rule.
Authorization to post one approved clip does not change which source videos or B-roll may be used.
The source decision does not modify the requirement that each clip contain a complete standalone lesson, story, or point.
The number of clips authorized for publication does not alter caption color, font, effects, lettering, or position.
The publishing authorization does not change the clean-editing, visual-effects, or transition standards.
The source decision does not change the requirement to remove distracting wind noise.
The immediate authorization to publish one clip does not change the submission channel, batch size, deadline, storage, or review-link workflow.
The source decision limits publication count but does not modify the standard for selecting strong and impactful source moments.
